note: total_cycles and partial_cycles of each whole run, with its version (sync_id) and run_cycles, read on 2026-10-08 to supplement the original recording, which predates those fields. The replay fills a recorded row only when its sync_id and run_cycles match: a run returned by a production-day-filtered request is clipped to that window, with prorated cycles, and must not be paired with the whole run's totals. See ReplayClient.
